name: Ashy to Classy
description: Ashy to Classy: a vintage console that cleans records (hiss, crackle, pops, hum) or ages them (vinyl noise, crackle, scratches, buzz), with eight stackable filters (Lo-Fi, Water, Dynamic, Tinny, Radio, Hollow, Sweep, Muffled) and a real analog Tape, each on its own key with its own mixer.
author: The Disk King
